text: This report seeks authority to reallocate funds for construction of the Effluent Disinfection System Upgrades Project at Ashbridges Bay Treatment Plant. The reallocation is needed for potential resolution of claims related to the project.

City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1.
